events.verdict: Markkanen (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bulls.
Markkanen (UTA) places his hand momentarily on Vucevic's (CHI) arm before immediately removing his hand.
Collier (UTA) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Giddey's (CHI) hand that is on the ball, as he defends the jump shot attempt.
White (CHI) is moving alongside George's (UTA) path and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Vucevic (CHI) firms up over his left leg in Collier's (UTA) path prior to the contact.
Sensabaugh (UTA) and Okoro (CHI) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Nurkic (UTA) firms up over his right leg in White's (CHI) path prior to the contact.
White (CHI) places his hand momentarily on Markkanen's (UTA) side and immediately removes his hand.
White (CHI) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Sensabaugh (UTA) does not establish a legal guarding position outside the RA prior to the contact from Giddey (CHI).
Nurkic (UTA) firms up over his left leg in Okoro's (CHI) path prior to the contact.
Okoro (CHI) momentarily applies his hand to Markkanen's (UTA) hip and he immediately removes his hand as Markkanen enters his upward shooting motion.
Collier (UTA) momentarily applies his hand to White's (CHI) front and immediately removes his hand as he defends the drive.
Nurkic (UTA) applies his hand to Giddey's (CHI) side and the contact during the shot attempt is marginal.
White (CHI) directly contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Markkanen's (UTA) hand after the release.
Buzelis (CHI) and Nurkic (UTA) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.

Giddey (CHI) brings his left hand towards the ball, and the ensuing contact with Nurkic's (UTA) head/face during his follow-through is marginal.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Buzelis (CHI) turns into Markkanen (UTA) and delivers body to body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) moves alongside Giddey's (CHI) path and does not deliver any contact as he contests Giddey's driving shot attempt.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) raises his arm up towards the ball and the contact with Giddey's (CHI) arm after he is no longer in contact with the ball during his tip-in attempt is marginal.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Markkanen (UTA) leaves his feet to shoot and his left foot returns to the floor while he is still in possession of the ball.
Vucevic (CHI) moves alongside Markkanen's (UTA) path and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
George (UTA) legally contests Vucevic's (CHI) shot in the paint.
Okoro (CHI) and Nurkic (UTA) briefly engage and disengage in the paint.
The play originates outside the LDB. Okoro (CHI) is the secondary defender on the play and does not establish a legal guarding position outside the RA prior to the contact with Collier (UTA).
Giddey (CHI) deflects the ball away from Sensabaugh (UTA) as he defends the drive.
Possession is awarded to the Jazz. There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if the ball touches Vucevic's (CHI) right leg before going out of bounds.
Vucevic (CHI) directly contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Markkanen's hand after the release.
Okoro (CHI) and Nurkic (UTA) come together at the same spot, and the contact as they attempt to secure the rebound is marginal.
